cases.prompt: Given a documented multi-depth tropical landscape and a target 9:16 wallpaper or interactive layered scene, create the requested output and record its depth-order manifest.
assertions: Each actual exported layer has a unique contiguous integer index, farthest first.
Depth centroids and transform amplitudes are monotone except explicitly documented physical exceptions.
No duplicated source regions, missing occluders, edge halos, or invented output assets are claimed as verified.
cases.grader: Inspect the exported manifest and actual rendered frames or image; compare against the source and record evidence.

cases.prompt: Given only a single still photograph, no device orientation permission, or no eligible depth segmentation, explain or implement a safe fallback.
assertions: Do not claim gyroscope-responsive native iPhone wallpaper or Apple Spatial Scene eligibility from a still image.
Preserve original pixels when no image edit is authorized; distinguish estimated depth from measured depth.
Report unavailable assets, permissions, or hardware tests as BLOCKED or NOT TESTED.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and permission fallback; verify unsupported claims are absent.

cases.prompt: Render or review the maximum safe parallax displacement on a mobile viewport with reduced motion enabled and complex foliage/water boundaries.
assertions: Maintain stable horizon, plausible reflections, inpainted disocclusions, and overscan coverage.
Honor reduced-motion controls and cap movement; verify real-device performance only when measured.
Present layer count, ordering, test conditions, observed failures, and unverified assumptions accurately.
cases.grader: Inspect representative render frames, mobile crop, accessibility behavior, and measured performance when available.
